# Tanya's Sprint Retro

Tanya: "We shipped the async decision widget. Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter. The Zephyr integration was the key unlock."

segments.exact: We shipped the async decision widget.
Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.
The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Enacts communal sharing through the plural first-person pronoun framing shipping as a collective undifferentiated team achievement.
Reports a completed, settled operational delivery without qualification.

observations.why: Plain factual assertion stating sprint velocity metric.

payload.rationale: This document is a sprint retro covering three load-bearing concepts: (1) the async decision widget shipped — connects to Position_Sprint4ThesisProven and Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus/Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning which frame the product thesis the widget proves; (2) velocity 23 points — directly matches Obs_TinaVelocity and StyleObs_Sprint4_MetricAnchor (the exact quote 'Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter'); (3) Zephyr integration as key unlock — matches Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock and Obs_ZephyrRateLimitResolved (the blocker that was cleared). I also expanded Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint (next sprint focus from the same retro), Position_PricingTier25Plus and Position_PricingTwelveDollars (pricing thread that evolved across sprints and could be referenced), and Position_WebhookArchitecture (architecture decision tied to Zephyr). Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat was included because the anti-Slack positioning is the frame the widget validates. I did not expand Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams or Position_ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform as they are one degree removed from this retro's content.
